sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Public SDK v1 adapter for the document display unit, the document's own tolerance policy, typed length/angle parsing and the command prompt's coordinate grammar. The host dispatch calls the existing core services; no parser or unit table is duplicated.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Tolerance is read, not written; display/page unit mutation is not exposed. Local-frame/CPlane resolution and interactive input stay host-owned. This record does not close the L2, its manual gates or the SDK scope of L3-004/005/006.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Typed builder/command parameters: Dimension/ParameterDomain/ParameterSpec/ParameterValue mirror the document owner's request::OptionDomain and request::Value, and the host runs OptionDomain::check and CommandSchema::apply. Bounds are canonical (mm/degrees), step and the integer count rule apply, defaults are typed, required/unknown names are refused, and one call is bounded to 128 declarations and 128 values.
l3_open: builder parameter editor/UI parity belongs to M04 and the command registry
CPlane local-to-world frame resolution stays host-owned
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: The exported rule is the one command admission uses; the application has no builder parameter editor yet, so UI parity is not claimed. This record does not close the L2 or its manual gates.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Tolerance write (host-tested): validated policy mutation with one Undo.
Native ToleranceDemo + DLL test (set 0.01 mm, Undo restores 0.001 mm).
